messages:
deploy-bot: Hotfix request: service `embeds-eu` -> prod-eu. Symptom: short spike of 503s after recent quant tweak. Owner: carmen. Patch: lower cache soft-limit + earlier eviction. Change window: immediate (5m prep). Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/embeds-kv-hotfix

carmen: quick summary: validated in staging under burst. Patch reduces memory footprint and avoids transient K/V churn. Need expedited ops lane; customer impact on EU search.

rui: ack. What's the rollback plan? Paste commands & abort conditions.

ops-lead: Rollback (staged):
```
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/embeds-eu --to-revision=4
kubectl scale deploy/embeds-eu --replicas=6
```
Abort if 5xx >1% for 5m or memory >85% on canary nodes. Require 2 approvals + ops-lead.

alex: +1 :thumbsup: I can watch metrics for 20m post-deploy.

maria: +1 :thumbsup: will take pager for 30m.

deploy-bot: Approval threshold reached. Starting canary: image registry.redwood/embeds:hotfix-kv-2026-03-23 -> 10% to eu-canary.

carmen: release note draft: https://docs.redwood/internal/release-notes/embeds-kv-hotfix-2026-03-23 (RCA + rollback).

ops-lead: Monitoring live. If error delta >0.5% vs baseline for 3m, abort and run rollback above.

alex: canary metrics look good: 503s down from 3.2% -> 0.4% in 5m.

maria: Observability green. Recommend ramp to 50% in 10m and keep pager pinned.

deploy-bot: Canary bumped to 50%. Full rollout scheduled after 15m stable window.

carmen: thanks team, updating notes and will close after post-rollout check.

maria: Post-rollout 25m: all green, errors 0.2%, latency stable. Ending pager watch in 5m. :tada:
